newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland to establish A$1.6 bln works fund.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland to establish A$1.6 bln works fund.

text.p: The Australian state of Queensland announced a three year A$1.6 billion Special Infrastructure Program in its 1996/97 (July/June) budget.
Treasurer Joan Sheldon said the money will be additional to normal capital works, and in 1996/97 will boost overall capital works to more than A$4 billion.

The program will cost A$215 million in 1996/97, "which will be funded from the remaining amounts in the Queensland Infrastructure Financing Fund and proceeds from the sale of the State Gas Pipeline," Sheldon told parliament.

In the following two years, the package will be funded by capital restructuring of government owned corporations, proceeds from the Suncorp/QIDC/Metway merger and other asset sales, such as surplus land, Sheldon said.
